description.value: At 2nd level, a black mage can use his knowledge of the elements and shield allies for a brief duration. As an immediate action, a black mage can shield himself and allies within 30 feet from elemental damage, gaining Elemental Resistance equal to his black mage level against all elements (earth, fire, ice, lightning, water, and wind) until the start of the black mage's next turn. A black mage may use elemental shield a number of times per day equal to 3 + his Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1).
